    • hasOwner

      boolean hasOwner()
      Checks to see if the skull has an owner 检查该头颅是否拥有拥有者
      返回:
      true if the skull has an owner 若该头颅拥有拥有者则为 true

    • getOwner

      String getOwner()
      Gets the owner of the skull, if one exists 获取该头颅的拥有者（若存在）
      返回:
      the owner of the skull or null if the skull does not have an owner 该头颅的拥有者，若头颅没有拥有者则为 null

    • setOwner

      boolean setOwner(String name)
      Sets the owner of the skull 设置该头颅的拥有者

      Involves a potentially blocking web request to acquire the profile data for the provided name. 此过程涉及一个可能阻塞的网络请求，以获取所提供名称对应的档案数据。

      参数:
      name - the new owner of the skull 该头颅的新拥有者
      返回:
      true if the owner was successfully set 若拥有者设置成功则为 true

    • setPlayerProfile

      void setPlayerProfile(PlayerProfile profile)
      Sets this skull to use the supplied Player Profile, which can include textures already prefilled. 设置此头颅使用提供的玩家档案（Player Profile），其中可以包含已预填充的材质。
      参数:
      profile - The profile to set this Skull to use, may not be null 要设置此头颅使用的档案，不可为 null

    • getPlayerProfile

      PlayerProfile getPlayerProfile()
      If the skull has an owner, per hasOwner(), return the owners PlayerProfile 若该头颅拥有拥有者（见 hasOwner()），则返回拥有者的 PlayerProfile
      返回:
      The profile of the owner, if set 拥有者的档案（若已设置）
